title: Old Parliament House, Athens

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain on the north courtyard immediately beyond the modeled entrance steps. Exact tread levels are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap relation 19040143 supplies the named historic building. Its seven outer ways form one 32-corner ring, including the front and rear courtyard recesses, both central porticos and projecting wings.
mapIdentity.scope: The seven native members of the building relation form its exact 32-corner ring. The central four-column porticos occupy the two mapped projections. The open stairs and courtyard approaches extend beyond the portico faces.

note: Two cleared August 2014 photos establish the north portico, stairs, recessed red wall, pale Ionic columns and stepped parapets. The south portico uses its mapped outline and a proportional interpretation. The original unflattened terrain sets local grade.
